text:
שלום עולם
תודה רבה על העזרה
notes: Expected text is the /ActualText payload the generator wrote, which is authoritative
per ISO 32000-1 §14.9.4 — but per corpus/AGENT.md rule 5 an agent may not flip it to
verified: a human must confirm that this is the text a correct reader should return.
Niqqud-free; every asserted word is four letters or more so the word-boundary check
cannot match by coincidence (דוח inside חודש is the known trap).
Public Hebrew half of the no-silent-reversal control (crates/pdfrtl-core/tests/
no_silent_reversal.rs asserts שלום, עולם and תודה).
Oracle warning: pdftotext drops RTL /ActualText text entirely — see docs/problems/0001.
